style_when: the story is about change after hours — automation displacing shifts, a market open all night, capacity running while people sleep
prompt: In a dark data hall rack row at blue hour, one leased GPU compute node glows amber between dark perforated-metal server bays, cool cobalt window light from the left brushes a brushed-steel rack face. A 35mm architectural photograph, deep blue ambient, the warm rack status LEDs are the only interior light, long contact shadows, idle capacity hanging in the air. Framing rule: extreme asymmetry, hero node low-right on thirds, dark racks receding into negative space. No people, no text, no logos, fine film grain.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, watermarks, legible UI text
rationale: Architectural night suits the story's central risk: utilisation after hours. The blue-hour data hall makes idle rented capacity feel physical, while the warm rack light becomes the sole sign of work. This avoids the sterile studio object and grounds the cost in a real operating environment.
cue: the saving breaks whenever the box sits idle
subject: a leased GPU compute node glowing amber in a dark rack row
core_thesis: Amazon's 44x classifier saving is a utilisation bet: the self-hosted GPU costs the same per hour whether idle or at 5,600 tickets, so the headline saving only materialises when the box is busy enough.
core_conflict: fixed rented instance-hour cost vs variable token billing; break-even at 63 tickets/hour and half-capacity headroom
composition: extreme asymmetry, hero node low-right on thirds with receding dark racks

input.prompt:
In a dark data hall rack row at blue hour, one leased GPU compute node glows amber between dark perforated-metal server bays, cool cobalt window light from the left brushes a brushed-steel rack face. A 35mm architectural photograph, deep blue ambient, the warm rack status LEDs are the only interior light, long contact shadows, idle capacity hanging in the air. Framing rule: extreme asymmetry, hero node low-right on thirds, dark racks receding into negative space. No people, no text, no logos, fine film grain.

Do not include: people, faces, hands, garbled text, random lettering, numbers, signage, watermarks, UI, logos.
